_comment: The LANA engine folder the client packages at <resources>/engine (electron-local-engine.js), built by scripts/build-engine.js from this LANA-AI commit with the backend's scripts/release/build-engine-bundle.js on a matching computer, its node_modules installed with npm ci. treeSha256 is sha256 over one line per file (path, bytes, sha256), engine-manifest.json left out. Change the commit only together with a rebuild of every platform's entry. 0d9a94aae (2026-11-23): local first per request (a busy or failed local Pip goes to the box's Forge or Forge; Retry after a stop runs remote; data API 1.38). Release 4.2.0 (2026-11-23): macos-arm64 and macos-x64 built on the Apple-chip build Mac (macos-x64 under Rosetta 2 with the darwin-x64 Electron), windows-x64 on a Windows Server 2022 Azure VM, linux-x64 on an Ubuntu 22.04 (glibc 2.35) Azure VM; each loaded in the client's Electron for its system. Archives: lana-build-parts <target>/engine-0d9a94aaec65.tar.gz.
